BRANDING / 01 OF 06

Big DJ Bash

An identity with the volume turned up.

A bold identity for a platform that brings live music, nearby events and ticket discovery into one place.

THE PROJECT

The idea behind the identity.

Big DJ Bash makes it easier to discover live events, explore nearby venues and compare ticket options. The design brings that experience together with a confident wordmark and a simple, recognisable visual language.

DESIGN DIRECTION

Made for the main stage.

The logotype brings together expressive lettering and a music-inspired symbol. A monochrome palette keeps the identity direct and distinctive, whether it appears on a small screen or a larger brand application.

THE VISUAL LANGUAGE

Colour sets the tone.

White#FFFFFF
Midnight#121725
Black#000000
TYPOGRAPHY

Source Sans Pro

Clear, approachable typography that keeps the interface easy to scan.

IN APPLICATION

From identity to interface.

The visual system carries into the app through dark surfaces, high-contrast type and a consistent treatment of navigation and event discovery.
